headword: {料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}

definitions.explanation: A class or school where participants learn how to cook various dishes, often focusing on specific cuisines or techniques.

examples.japanese: {料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}に{通|かよ}う。
{友達|ともだち}とイタリア{料理|りょうり}の{料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I attended an Italian cooking class with a friend.

examples.japanese: {料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}で{和食|わしょく}の{基本|きほん}を{学|まな}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm learning the basics of Japanese cuisine at a cooking class.

examples.japanese: オンライン{料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}なら{自宅|じたく}でプロの{技|わざ}が{学|まな}べる。
examples.english: With an online cooking class, you can learn professional techniques at home.

notes:
Composed of {料理|りょうり} (cooking, dishes) + {教室|きょうしつ} (classroom, class). Refers to both one-time cooking workshops and ongoing cooking schools. Many department stores, community centers, and cooking supply companies offer regular {料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ} classes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}に{通|かよ}う: to attend a cooking class (regularly)
- {料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}に{参加|さんか}する: to participate in a cooking class
- {料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}を{開|ひら}く: to open/run a cooking class
- オンライン{料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}: online cooking class
- {和食|わしょく}{料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}: Japanese cuisine cooking class
- {親子|おやこ}{料理教室|りょうりきょうしつ}: parent-child cooking class

RELATED WORDS:
- {料理|りょうり}{学校|がっこう}: culinary school — more formal/professional training institution
- クッキング{教室|きょうしつ}: cooking class (using English loanword)
- {教室|きょうしつ}: classroom; class — the general term; used in many compounds like {英会話|えいかいわ}{教室|きょうしつ} (English conversation class) and {書道|しょどう}{教室|きょうしつ} (calligraphy class)

USAGE:
The structure [topic] + {教室|きょうしつ} is very productive in Japanese and refers to classes in that topic, whether one-off or recurring.
